LanguageData.MA_TerrainDesc: Paint any terrain – soil, sand, water, stone, floors. Click to choose the terrain (right-click to change it), then drag a rectangle, oval or line. Water is never put under buildings or people.
LanguageData.MA_PlantsDesc: Plant trees, bushes, grass or crops. Choose the plant and the density, then drag over the area.
LanguageData.MA_ClearDesc: Remove plants, rocks, filth, items or everything in the area. People and your own buildings are never removed.
LanguageData.MA_MountainDesc: Raise a mountain of any rock or ore, or change the roof (overhead mountain, thin rock roof, none).
LanguageData.MA_DeepDesc: Paint resources for the deep drill (steel, plasteel, uranium, chemfuel …) or remove them.
LanguageData.MA_ObjectDesc: Place geysers, ancient things, ruins, minerals, items, buildings or animals. Q / E rotate.
LanguageData.MA_NoSpace: There is a person or your building in the way.
LanguageData.MA_UndoDesc: Undo the last change of Map Architect (also Ctrl+Z). Up to 40 steps.
